SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application a
a.hire_status = '已录用'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employment_info WHERE status = '已确认'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employment_info WHERE status = '待审核'

SELECT j.title AS label, c.name AS extra, COUNT(a.id) AS amount FROM job_application a LEFT JOIN job j ON a.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN company c ON j.company_id = c.id
GROUP BY j.id, j.title, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC, j.title LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.name AS label, c.type AS extra, COUNT(a.id) AS amount FROM job_application a LEFT JOIN job j ON a.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN company c ON j.company_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.type ORDER BY amount DESC, c.name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(s.major, '未填写') AS label, NULL AS extra, COUNT(a.id) AS amount FROM job_application a LEFT JOIN student s ON a.student_id = s.id
GROUP BY COALESCE(s.major, '未填写') ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.apply_time, '%Y-%m') AS label, NULL AS extra, COUNT(a.id) AS amount FROM job_application a
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.apply_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label

SELECT a.status AS label, NULL AS extra, COUNT(a.id) AS amount FROM job_application a
GROUP BY a.status ORDER BY amount DESC
SELECT e.company_name AS label, NULL AS extra, COUNT(e.id) AS amount FROM employment_info e WHERE e.status = '已确认' GROUP BY e.company_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 10
